basis: STRATEGIES.md, ANCHORS.md (sections 10-17), CLEANROOM.md; data-only findings from the Yajnadevam and Mahadevan transcriptions, Laursen 2010 Fig. 11, CDLI.
corpus_requirements: Any Indus-sign inscriptions not in data/derived/merged-corpus-reading-order.json or data/im77/: new excavations, ICIT-only texts, newly published Gulf Type seals. Deduplicate identical (site, text). Reading order first-read-first.

predictions.name: Repetition avoidance
predictions.statement: In new home (Indus-valley) texts of 4-6 signs, the share with any repeated sign is <= 0.35 of the chance rate computed from the new corpus's own sign frequencies.
predictions.falsifier: Ratio >= 0.7 (the level of readable scripts) with >= 150 texts.

predictions.name: Foreign texts are led by person signs
predictions.statement: In new Indus-sign texts found outside the Indus valley (Gulf, Mesopotamia, Iran, Central Asia), >= 15% begin with a person or doubled-person sign (Wells 90/91; Mahadevan 1 and its doubled forms).

predictions.name: Person + number block abroad
predictions.statement: In the same new foreign texts, a person/doubled-person sign directly adjacent to a stroke group occurs in >= 10%, and the stroke count varies between texts while the figure stays fixed.

predictions.name: No home opener abroad
predictions.statement: New foreign texts begin with a home opener (Wells 817/861/820; Mahadevan 267/391) in <= 5%.

predictions.name: Regional fusion of fish + arrow
predictions.statement: Among new texts containing either the stroked fish (Wells 226) or the sequence plain fish + arrow (Wells 220-520), the share of the fused form is higher at Mohenjo-daro than at Harappa.
predictions.falsifier: Fused share at Harappa >= fused share at Mohenjo-daro with >= 15 cases at each site.

predictions.name: Leaf counts are not binary weights
predictions.statement: On new two-sided tablets with a tall-stroke + leaf face, value 3 is at least as common as value 2.
predictions.falsifier: Value 3 < half of value 2 with >= 40 leaf faces.

predictions.name: No local place-name signs
predictions.statement: A new site with >= 50 deduplicated seals has at most 2 signs over-represented there after BH-FDR 5% (one-sided Fisher against all other sites).
predictions.falsifier: >= 6 surviving site-specific signs at one new site.

notes: Frozen before any new data were seen. Harness: extend prereg/test_prereg.py.
